title_en: "Wise Multicultural Lab Life": Advisory Workshop for Korean Members of Multicultural STEM Labs
summary: The department has announced an advisory workshop titled "Wise Multicultural Lab Life" (「슬기로운 다문화 연구실 생활」) for Korean (domestic) members of multicultural science and engineering laboratories. Only the title of the notice was provided, so the date, location, registration method and whether attendance is mandatory are not known. Please check the original notice or contact the department office (contact details are in the original notice) for these details.
applies_to: Korean (domestic) members of multicultural laboratories in science and engineering fields, as stated in the title. The notice text provided does not say whether attendance is mandatory or give any further limits.
translation:
Title: 「슬기로운 다문화 연구실 생활」 ("Wise Multicultural Lab Life") – Notice of an Advisory Workshop for Korean (Domestic) Members of Multicultural Science and Engineering Laboratories

[Only the title of this notice was provided. No body text, image or attachment was available, so none was read or translated. The date, time, location, registration procedure and any requirements are not stated in the text provided. Please refer to the original notice or contact the department office; the contact details are in the original notice.]
